page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, with an ornamental fleuron band above the title. No margin notes. Title block centred at top, dedicatory list of names in hanging-indent paragraphs, closing italic line at foot right.

main_text.l: Nobilissimis, generosissimis Prudentissimis
VIRIS
Dn. NICOLAO à WATTENWEIL, Baroni in Diesbach/
Domino in Jegistorff/ antiquo stemmatis splendore Nobilissimo,
Generosissimo.
Dn. EMANUELI WURSTEMBERGERO, Domini
Rodolphi Wurstembergeri in florentissima Reip. Bernensi
Tribunatu Romanicae Provinciae Quaestoratu cum laude
defuncti, Filio, omni literarum genere Exercitatissimo, Pru-
dentissimo.
Dn. CHRISTOPHORO STEIGERO, Domini Emanuelis
Steigeri ejusdem ditionis olim Quaestoris Meritissimi,
nunc chorum beatorum cingentis, Filio, acumine ingenii Per-
spicacissimo, Literatissimo.
Dn. ALBERTO STEIGERO, Domino in Wichdorff / ge-
neris nobilitate Clarissimo Suavissimo.
Dn. NICOLAO JENNERO, Domini Nicolai Jenneri Senatoris
Dignissimi, Filio Dignissimo, Humanissimo.
Dn. JACOBO FISCHERO, Domini Samuelis Fischeri in
illustri Reip. Bernensi quoad ditionem Germanicam Quaestoris
spectatissimi Filio, in Archivarum Registratura Labo-
riosissimo, Politissimo.
Dn. ANTHONIO KILCHBERGERO, Domini Anthonii
Kilchbergeri Tribuni plebis Consultissimi Filio, Erla-
chicarum copiarum in Gallia locum tenenti strenuissimo,
fortissimo.
Dn. ALBERTO BENOICT, Medicinae Doctoratu nobi-
litato, Laudatissimo, Doctissimo.

page.notes: Ornamental fleuron band at top is decorative and not transcribed. Scan shows a faded stain at left centre. The word "Wichdorff" is shown with a black-letter/ornamental initial W and is rendered approximately. "Wurstembergeri" and "Erlachicarum" are as printed. Names of the dedicatees are in small capitals; "Dn." abbreviations are printed in small capitals with stops.
